results.title: Holomorph of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$
results.caption: Abbreviation
results.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $A = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $n > 0$, let $A = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$, and write $(a, u)$ for the element of the holomorph $A \rtimes A^\times$ with $a \in A$ and $u \in A^\times$. results.title: Period of a Lucas sequence modulo $m$
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a Lucas sequence $U = U(P, Q)$ and a natural number $m$, the least period $\pi_U(m)$ of $U$ modulo $m$ is the minimal period of the pair $(0, 1)$ under the map $(x, y) \mapsto (y, P y - Q x)$ on pairs of residues modulo $m$, that is, the least $r > 0$ with $U_r \equiv 0 \pmod m$ and $U_{r+1} \equiv 1 \pmod m$, and $0$ if there is no such $r$.

results.title: Translated wired marginals converge to the wired density
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired marginals of the translated edge `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}` converge to the wired `q = 2` density of `e`.

results.title: Free density is at most each translated wired marginal
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free `q = 2` density of `e` is at most the wired marginal of `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}`.

results.title: Secant bound gives free–wired density agreement off a countable set
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Under the secant comparison `wired(p') ≤ free(p)` for `p' < p`, the free and wired densities of a box edge agree for all `p ∈ (0, 1)` outside a countable set, namely the discontinuities of the monotone wired density.

results.title: Equal wired densities from equal translated marginals
